annotations.title: Record a campaign's audience from the dashboard

description: Fill an API gap: record which segment/list a campaign or journey targets, as read from the platform's dashboard (e.g. via Claude in Chrome). Stored as 'seen-on-screen' with today's date on the latest snapshot.

item.description: Campaign or journey name or id.

segment.description: Segment or list name or id.

workspace.description: Workspace label. Defaults to the connected one, or "demo" when nothing is connected.

name: record_audience
title: Record an audience seen on screen
